description.text: Bitcoin is a digital currency that unlike traditional currencies does not rely on a centralized authority. Instead Bitcoin relies on a network of volunteers that collectively implement a replicated ledger and verify transactions. In this paper we analyze how Bitcoin uses a multi-hop broadcast to propagate transactions and blocks through the network to update the ledger replicas. We then use the gathered information to verify the conjecture that the propagation delay in the network is the primary cause for blockchain forks.

events.title: Rafmynt - fundur fyrir alla félagsmenn
events.place: stofa V-158 í VR-II við Hjarðarhaga

description.text: Fundur verður haldinn í félaginu miðvikudaginn 18. apríl í stofu V-158 í VR-II við Hjarðarhaga. Að venju hefst fundurinn með kaffidrykkju kl. 16:45, en kl. 17:00 heldur Gunnar Stefánsson prófessor við HÍ fyrirlestur sem hann nefnir Rafmynt: Bitcoin og broskallar. Í erindi sínu mun Gunnar fjalla um rafmyntir og taka dæmi um notkun Bitcoin og Broskalla. Farið verður yfir virkni myntanna gagnvart notanda, um uppbyggingu bunkakeðjunnar (blockchain) og hvernig fjármagnsfærslur fara fram.

events.title: CBDC conference and hackathon in Bergen
events.organiser: Norges Bank, Simula and the University of Bergen

description.text: The first CBDC conference was held in Bergen in October 2022, with Simula and the University of Bergen. The conference was research-oriented, with participants from academia, the FinTech community and central banks. Topics included Norges Bank's CBDC work, DeFi and legal issues, AML and CBDC, data protection, quantum technology and OpenCBDC. The conference was the kick-off for a hackathon on transferring CBDC tokens through bridges between openCBDC and EVM-compatible networks.

Norges Bank and Digdir arranged a brainstorming session on 22 November 2022. The theme was which existing problems a CBDC can solve, and which new opportunities a CBDC can provide to society. The same day started a technical hackathon, with groups programming solutions in Norges Bank's prototype.

events.title: Workshop on CBDC, IoT and machine-to-machine payments
events.organiser: Norges Bank and the Blockchain Lab at the University of Oslo

description.text: A technical workshop on CBDC, the Internet of Things and machine-to-machine payments was held at the University of Oslo on 10 January 2023. Lecturers from the Blockchain Lab covered blockchain technology, including IT security, environmental protection and processing capacity, and machine-to-machine communication and payments.
11 groups presented suggestions on the advantages of CBDCs at an event in Norges Bank's auditorium on 19 January 2023. The groups came from the hackathon started with Digdir.

description.text: The hackathon was for members of Fintech Norway and Virke and was held in person in Oslo on 15–17 March 2023. It was the most compact hackathon in this phase of Norges Bank's CBDC work and engaged private market participants with the prototype.

events.title: Er bitcoin vinnaren av krigen mot Iran?

description.text: Krigen mot Iran har tydeliggjort at landet kontrollerer Hormuzstredet. Nå signaliserer regimet at tankskip kan bli avkrevd toll, og at tollen skal kunne betales i bitcoin. Trolig for å omgå amerikanske sanksjoner.

Rett etter Iran-debatten spør vi om bitcoin er mulig som alternativ valuta i Gaza og på Vestbredden. Parisprotokollen fra Osloprosessen gjør israelske shekel til tvungent betalingsmiddel i de palestinske områdene.

events.title: Bitcoin-mining i Norge. For vanskelig å forstå, for lett å forby?

description.text: Bitcoin-mining har blitt et hett tema i norsk energidebatt. Hva skjer når en digital valuta møter en strømkrise og klimamål? I 2024 vedtok et flertall på Stortinget å tvinge regjeringen til å utrede et mulig forbud mot kryptovalutautvinning.

events.title: Bitcoin – Breaking new ground in the world of money

description.text: With millions upon millions invested by Silicon Valley investors, an industry is appearing that few understand, yet many have opinions on. Did the nerds really manage to reinvent something as basic as money? What opportunities and challenges does that bring? This panel deep from the trenches of this nascent industry will share their insights on where things are going, opportunities and pitfalls for aspiring entrepreneurs in the highly disruptive world of digital currency.

events.title: Hva skjer når Bitcoin og borgerlønn møtes?

description.text: Bitcoin og borgerlønn springer ut av ulike tradisjoner, men deler viktige ideer om individuell frihet, økonomisk selvstendighet og et mer åpent finanssystem. BIEN Norge i samarbeid med Mission Possible 2030 vil avholde en åpen samtale rundt borgerlønn og Bitcoin på Batteriet i Storggt. 32 i Oslo den 26. september kl. 13:00 – 16:00. Diskusjonen vil også presentere vår kommende seks måneder lange «pre-pilot». Denne skal undersøke om Bitcoin-økosystemet er modent for å støtte en lokalsamfunnsbasert ordning for borgerlønn – med et langsiktig mål om å gjennomføre en pilotperiode på 18 måneder.
